source: UK Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, Greenhouse gas reporting: conversion factors 2026 (flat file v1.2)
units: kg CO2e per passenger-km for transport; kg CO2e per room-night for accommodation

flight_long_haul.basis: 2026 UK GHG long-haul economy flight with radiative forcing

rail.basis: indicative rail proxy; UK national rail factor, not country-specific

road.basis: indicative average passenger car occupancy proxy

hotel.basis: fallback estimate; country/property-specific hotel factors should replace where available

country_coverage.India: approximate: transport and accommodation use proxies; not a verified country-specific factor set
country_coverage.Japan: approximate: transport and accommodation use proxies; not a verified country-specific factor set
country_coverage.Morocco: approximate: transport and accommodation use proxies; not a verified country-specific factor set
country_coverage.Indonesia: approximate: transport and accommodation use proxies; not a verified country-specific factor set

disclaimer: Indicative planning estimate, not a carbon inventory or offset claim. Only the long-haul flight factor is taken as a specific 2026 DESNZ factor here; other modes use disclosed proxies pending country/mode-specific workbook mapping.
